topic: Full Stack Capstone Integration and Testing
learningObjectives: Integrate frontend, backend, database, and UI/UX components into one application.
Validate complete user journeys across the application.
Identify and resolve integration issues before final delivery.

activities.title: Capstone Architecture Map
activities.instruction: Connect every major component of the capstone.

content.concept: A capstone architecture connects the user interface, frontend logic, backend APIs, database, authentication, and deployment environment.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: User Journey Validator
activities.instruction: Arrange the complete flow for a key user task.

content.concept: End-to-end validation checks whether a user can complete important tasks across all connected application layers.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Integration Issue Lab
activities.instruction: Select the likely source of each integration problem.

content.concept: Integration failures can originate in frontend state, API contracts, backend logic, database operations, authentication, or configuration.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Capstone Validation Builder
activities.instruction: Build a final validation plan for the application.

content.concept: A capstone validation plan combines functional, integration, UI, accessibility, security, and performance checks.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
